calls.summary: Cary Rakin and Cris Dizon discussed recording tools, comparing Growth Books and Firefly, with Cris noting they typically use Firefly. No specific pain points, product features, or next steps were identified in the brief exchange.

calls.title: Ravi Nagaraju and Cris Dizon
calls.summary: The meeting established a collaborative framework between Growth Book and Sony, with Cary Rakin emphasizing understanding Sony's requirements and providing support. Cris Dizon noted recent growth and the importance of aligning with Sony's evolving needs. Ravi Nagaraju shared positive initial experiences with Growth Book as an analytics tool, and highlighted a critical upcoming transition in May when Growth Book will replace Sony's internal platform. Challenges regarding metadata mapping were discussed, affecting migration success. Integration with enterprise tools poses further complexities and requires ongoing communication. Key feature enhancements and bandit algorithms were also raised as vital areas for improvement and strategic alignment.
calls.keywords: experimentation migration, integration challenges, bandit algorithms, enterprise tools, start/end date feature, data model mapping
calls.action_items:
**Ravindra Nagaraju**
Share internal data model details and mapping challenges with Growth Book if located to aid integration efforts (20:00)
Discuss with Angela about capabilities related to start and end date custom fields and communicate findings to Growth Book to clarify feature support (31:00)
Coordinate internal stakeholders to assess feasibility of sharing enterprise tool insights or QA versions for integration discussions with Growth Book (19:00)
Participate in upcoming workshop after next week to explore bandit and reinforcement learning capabilities with Growth Book (35:00)

**Cris Dizon**
Follow up with Growth Book engineering and product teams on release notes and onboarding materials for new features like start/end date and payload handling to improve Sony adoption (32:00)
Provide Sony with documentation on current bandit algorithms (Thompson sampling) and planned contextual bandits roadmap to support evaluation and adoption (28:00)
Initiate scheduling of detailed bandit strategy discussion sessions with Sony decision makers after their workshops to deepen collaboration (34:00)
Engage with Growth Book teams to improve clarity and transparency around data model and metadata for better Sony integration (20:00)

**Cary Rakin**
Support discussions on Growth Book’s bandit strategy and address Sony’s questions related to reinforcement learning and operationalization workflows (22:00)
Assist in organizing ongoing feature request categorization by program/team alongside Sony’s internal structure to streamline progress tracking (18:00)
Provide contextual input on adoption impact of bandit strategy development and support pitch to Sony leadership to facilitate internal buy-in (25:00)
